title: DOJ Charges Venezuelan Man Shot by ICE in Austin With Assaulting Federal Officer
detail: Federal prosecutors charged Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, the Venezuelan DoorDash driver shot by an ICE officer in North Austin on Sept. 20, with assaulting a federal officer. A complaint alleges he refused commands to exit his vehicle during a targeted stop of a person with a final removal order, sped away and struck an officer with his side mirror; he faces up to 20 years if convicted. The complaint also says the officer who fired was not wearing a body camera and another agent turned off his during the pursuit.
